items.text: Seahawks rookie RB Jadarian Price is questionable to return due to a chest injury.
49ers WR Mike Evans has a hip injury and is questionable to return today.
items.implication: Monitor; other 49ers WRs elevate if out

items.text: Commanders ruled out QB Jayden Daniels with left elbow injury. Last similar injury missed four games. Carted off earlier.
items.why: Left elbow injury mid-game, awkward bend
items.implication: Major loss; backup in, multi-week concern possible
items.opportunity: Commanders skill upside/downgrade depending on backup

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury; replaced by Tyson Bagent. Imaging Monday. Walking under own power later.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 3; Bagent streamer potential short-term
items.opportunity: Bears pass game to Bagent; check severity

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE. RJ Harvey inactive. If ignored preseason, grab Jonah Coleman now.
Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active today.
items.implication: Start in fantasy; monitor for flak/limitations

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey is inactive today.
items.opportunity: Increased role for J.K. Dobbins and Jonah Coleman

items.text: Eagles say RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) is questionable to return today.
items.implication: Monitor return; Gainwell upside if out

items.text: Joe Burrow officially active vs Texans after questionable (back). Also Olave, McMillan, Hendrickson active; Tua inactive.
Puka Nacua (hip) sounds like true game-time decision for MNF.
items.why: No practice Fri/Sat; different hip issue per McVay
items.implication: Hold/start decision pending late word; trending wrong direction later reports

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish, official status likely ~2:30pm ET. Would wear flak if plays.
items.why: Optimism reports + Rap bullish tone; cracked rib but practice progress
items.implication: Start-worthy WR2 if active but dock for limited snaps/risk
items.opportunity: Role intact if plays; flak jacket noted

items.text: Chris Olave (hamstring) sounds fine, no real docks for us.
items.why: Practice progress, expected to play reports

items.text: Expecting decent look at Jonah Coleman with RJ Harvey (hamstring) sounding doubtful/not expected.
items.why: Hamstring, ETR not expected; later confirmed inactive
items.implication: Coleman opportunity in Broncos backfield alongside Dobbins
items.opportunity: Carries/targets for Coleman; Dobbins lead runner

items.text: Expecting decent look at Germie Bernard with Michael Pittman (foot) out.
items.implication: Bernard YAC upside in Steelers offense

items.text: ETR weekend fantasy reports summary: GTD Ladd McConkey (cracked rib, optimism + flak jacket) and Puka Nacua (hip); not expected RJ Harvey (hamstring); expected Chris Olave, Joe Burrow, Kaelon Black, Jalen McMillan (snap count); OUT Zay Flowers and Michael Pittman.
items.why: Compiled weekend reports ahead of Sunday slate
items.implication: Key status windows for lineup locks and DFS
items.opportunity: Monitor McConkey/Nacua; beneficiaries for OUT players

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) downgraded to OUT.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Ravens WRs

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT with foot injury.
items.implication: Sit Pittman; Metcalf WR2 lock, Bernard upside

items.text: Agrees with Germie Bernard stash (YAC man, Pittman out); good fit with what McCarthy likes. Also Elijah Sarratt with Lane/Flowers out.
items.why: Pittman OUT opens role; YAC fit
